comments_text: Sequence analysis: It has a unique sequence which shows 32.7% to plant hevin-like WANP-1a. The bacteriocin was produced after 12 hours in the lag phase and the use of Diaion HP-20 hydrophobic resin increased yield. Partial sequence was determined and the entire sequence was deduced. Peptide stability: This peptide is thermal stable, pH tolerant, and resistant to proteases. Reducing agent DTT had no effect on peptide activity or migration on gel. Activity: Active against B. subtilis (MIC ~2 uM), S. aureus (MIC ~2 uM), E. coli (MIC ~7 uM), V. cholerae, P. aeruginosa (MIC ~15 uM), and L. monocytogenes (MIC ~22 uM). Also, MRSA (MIC 6-12 uM), anti-VRE (MIC >16 uM), S-mutans strain DIGK119 (MIC >24 uM), G-parahaemolysans strain SKVG1 (MIC > 24 uM), and S-gordonii (MIC > 24 uM). Warning: other bacteria not tested. Chemical modification: The peptide has a disulfide bond pattern similar to beta defensins. Structure: The 3D structure is determined by crystallographic method at 2 A Singh PK et al., 2015. It consists of 4 beta-strands forming a twisted sheet. You can rotate, zoom, and view the 3D structure here in the PDB. Updated 6/2015; Jan2016; 7/2021; 10/2025
